Dhaka [Bangladesh], December 25 (ANI): Bangladesh PM Sheikh Hasina on Sunday said she accepted leadership of the Awami League in view of the global economic situation, The Daily Star reported.

She made the statement while exchanging greetings with party leaders and activists at Ganabhaban after being elected as Awami League's President for the 10th time.
